newTaskDialog.title: New Agent task
newTaskDialog.description: Choose the execution environment, model, thinking level, and first task together. Advanced options can override the current provider route and concurrency limit.
newTaskDialog.localDescription: Work directly in the project folder; suitable for read-only tasks or tasks that explicitly do not need isolation.
newTaskDialog.worktreeDescription: Create an isolated Git branch and managed working directory; recommended for file changes and parallel tasks.
newTaskDialog.worktreeUnavailable: This folder is not a Git repository that can create a Worktree. Choose Local.
newTaskDialog.worktreeCreateFailed: Could not create the managed Worktree
newTaskDialog.noModels: No models available; configure one in Settings first
newTaskDialog.worktreeNamingDescription: Leave either field blank to generate it automatically. A custom branch must be new and valid; existing branches are never overwritten or deleted.
newTaskDialog.firstTaskPlaceholder: Describe the goal, scope, constraints, and acceptance check. Prepare fills the Composer so you can review and send it.
newTaskDialog.advancedDescription: Routing is provider-wide; concurrency is limited to 1–16. An active turn never changes route silently.
newTaskDialog.ready: Task prepared; review the first message and send it
newTaskDialog.failureRecovery: Any created Worktree is kept for inspection in the Worktree panel. This error never automatically overwrites project files.
